name: Deccan Gold Mines Ltd
title: Deccan Gold Mines Ltd - 512068 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Promoter-led gold and critical-minerals story with no reported capacity discipline; Jonnagiri ~100 kg refined to date, FY27 guide 600 kg, and a Rs.60–100 Cr funding gap for Kyrgyzstan.

triggers.label: Kyrgyz funding gap Rs.60–100 Cr
triggers.quote: we require up to Rs.100 Crores at least minimum Rs.60 Crores we require to complete that Kyrgyz project

triggers.label: Rs.55 Cr diverted to Geomysore
triggers.quote: we had to invest another Rs.55 Crores, which has been actually earmarked to complete the Kyrgyz project

triggers.label: FY27 gold 600 kg target
triggers.quote: the production forecast for FY2027 is 600kg

guidance.quote: the production forecast for FY2027 is 600kg
we have taken a conservative estimate of about 160k g
by next April, we have to submit the mining lease application

red_flags.label: Funding gap for Kyrgyz project
red_flags.quote: we require up to Rs.100 Crores at least minimum Rs.60 Crores we require to complete that Kyrgyz project

red_flags.label: Ganajur mine stuck in litigation
red_flags.quote: our expectation is there in front of High Court and we are also following the Supreme Court

red_flags.label: Repeated timeline slippage
red_flags.quote: Yes, I admit there are few delays but some of the things are out of our hands

red_flags.label: Investor queries not answered
red_flags.quote: Till the next investor call, we keep on writing mails to you. They are not replied.

evasions.quote: Other than that, there is no clear hedging or risk management policy in terms of gold price if it falls down
I cannot disclose beyond that at this point.
FPO planning would come only after the present projects get into.
